A scale-play composite photograph: a giant white leather low-top sneaker with black side stripes and a black heel tab, worn on an enormous leg with a tall white ribbed crew sock, rising vertically from the bottom edge of the frame and seen from below at a low angle so the entire tread of the sole reads in foreshortening. Sitting on top of that giant shoe, a miniature version of a man with the face from the reference photo, knees forward and legs dangling over the edge of the sole so his calves and shoes hang in front of the midsole in genuine occlusion, a soft contact shadow beneath him where he rests on the upper edge; torso leaning slightly back, right hand raised to touch the brim of his cap, left hand extended outward palm open, mouth slightly parted, looking toward camera through futuristic white wraparound sunglasses in an expression of contained surprise.

Wardrobe on the miniature (menswear): a dark olive-green curved-brim baseball cap with small embroidered lettering, futuristic white wraparound sunglasses with a slim white frame and reflective lenses, an oversized black cotton t-shirt with large white tribal flame graphics curving across the chest and a small “99” print at the collarbone, a thin silver chain necklace with a cross pendant, a black nylon crossbody sling bag worn diagonally across the chest, extremely wide-leg washed charcoal-black baggy jeans with heavy vertical fading and raised raw-edge appliqué flame patterns stitched down both legs, a black watch on the wrist, tall white ribbed crew socks, and white leather low-top sneakers with black stripes identical to the giant one; a silver ring on the extended hand.

Background: a panelled gate or wall of dark green-grey painted wood with pronounced horizontal mouldings forming a clean rectangular grid, a strip of grey pavement visible at the bottom edge — a neutral backdrop with structure but no distracting texture.

Lighting: flat diffused overcast daylight, frontal, no hard directional shadows, low contrast, neutral-cool temperature, the miniature receiving exactly the same soft light as the giant shoe and the backdrop, with a faint glint sliding across the white sunglass lenses and no other added speculars.

Camera: vertical framing, low angle from ground level, the composition reading as an inverted T — the leg rising vertically from below, the shoe opening horizontally across the center, the figure seated on the axis; deep depth of field with everything sharp.

Details: visible leather grain and stitching on the sneaker upper, rubber tread pattern and shallow scuffing on the sole, ribbed sock texture, washed denim slub with raised frayed appliqué edges, screen-print texture on the flame graphic, natural skin texture on the miniature, matched grain across both scales.

Palette: dark green-grey backdrop as the cool dominant, black tee and charcoal denim as the anchor, olive cap as the muted mid value, and the white flame graphic, white socks, white sneakers and white sunglasses as the luminous accents — placed exactly where they separate the figure from the ground and rhyme between the two scales.

Ready for takeoff, even with nowhere to be.✈️

Prompt:
Vertical fashion campaign photograph shot in natural light: a woman with the face from the reference photo stands frontally beneath the wing of an abandoned propeller aircraft in a winter field, leaning lightly against the landing-gear tyre, one hand raised loosely to her chest and the other hanging at her side, weight on one leg with the other crossed over, shoulders relaxed, looking straight into the lens through dark sunglasses with a completely neutral expression. Wardrobe (womenswear): a washed denim-blue curved-brim baseball cap with small white embroidery, worn straight; black wraparound sunglasses with dark opaque lenses; a fitted black short-sleeve technical sports tee with royal blue raglan shoulder panels, thin white piping tracing the seams down the chest and sides, small white “STYVIO CLUB” script at the left chest and “LOS ANGELES” lettering at the right; a silver chain necklace; a black digital sports watch; black knee-length mesh athletic shorts with blue and white side stripes and small blue “STYVIO CLUB” and “LOS ANGELES” print at the hems; a silver carabiner waist chain hanging at the hip with crescent and star charms; tall scrunched white ribbed crew socks; and chunky white platform sneakers with lugged soles; blackwork tribal tattoos on the neck and one forearm. Hair: long jet-black hair, thick and messy on top with a spiky textured fringe falling forward over the brow, the rest tucked behind the ears and falling past the shoulders beneath the cap. Lighting: overcast winter daylight near dusk — diffuse, enveloping and directionless, cool in temperature and low in intensity. The aircraft wing acts as a natural gobo, filling the upper half of the frame and shading her from above so the light reaches her mostly bounced from the grass and the open sky behind; her face sits in soft shade with low fill under the chin, no hard shadows anywhere, flat descriptive modelling, with a faint cool sheen sliding across the dark sunglass lenses, the chain and the waist charms. Composition, a frame within the frame: the wing above, the fuselage and propeller blade to the left, and the landing gear behind her forming a metal enclosure on three sides; a bare winter treeline crossing at shoulder height; grass filling the lower third; the subject standing slightly left of center. Depth: four clearly stepped planes — the wing in the upper foreground, the subject and tyre in the main plane, the airfield and grass in the midground, and the treeline behind with a faint haze lowering its contrast, that subtle atmospheric perspective giving the sense of cold open country. Focus: medium depth of field, subject sharp, slight falloff on the near wing, treeline just softened; medium-long focal length with gentle compression. Grade: desaturated and cool with a green-blue cast in the shadows, the grass green kept restrained rather than pushed, lifted blacks, sky highlights washed almost to pure white, fine film grain. Palette: cool greys of sky and metal dominating almost monochromatically, black sportswear as the central anchor, royal blue panels and the denim cap as the single saturated colour family running top to bottom, muted grass green as the sustained secondary, and the white piping, socks and platform sneakers as the lightest values.

Wardrobe (womenswear): a washed denim-blue curved-brim baseball cap with small white embroidery, worn straight; black wraparound sunglasses with dark opaque lenses; a fitted black short-sleeve technical sports tee with royal blue raglan shoulder panels, thin white piping tracing the seams down the chest and sides, small white “STYVIO CLUB” script at the left chest and “LOS ANGELES” lettering at the right; a silver chain necklace; a black digital sports watch; black knee-length mesh athletic shorts with blue and white side stripes and small blue “STYVIO CLUB” and “LOS ANGELES” print at the hems; a silver carabiner waist chain hanging at the hip with crescent and star charms; tall scrunched white ribbed crew socks; and chunky white platform sneakers with lugged soles; blackwork tribal tattoos on the neck and one forearm. Hair: long jet-black hair, thick and messy on top with a spiky textured fringe falling forward over the brow, the rest tucked behind the ears and falling past the shoulders beneath the cap. Lighting: overcast winter daylight near dusk — diffuse, enveloping and directionless, cool in temperature and low in intensity. The aircraft wing acts as a natural gobo, filling the upper half of the frame and shading her from above so the light reaches her mostly bounced from the grass and the open sky behind; her face sits in soft shade with low fill under the chin, no hard shadows anywhere, flat descriptive modelling, with a faint cool sheen sliding across the dark sunglass lenses, the chain and the waist charms. Focus: medium depth of field, subject sharp, slight falloff on the near wing, treeline just softened; medium-long focal length with gentle compression. Grade: desaturated and cool with a green-blue cast in the shadows, the grass green kept restrained rather than pushed, lifted blacks, sky highlights washed almost to pure white, fine film grain. Palette: cool greys of sky and metal dominating almost monochromatically, black sportswear as the central anchor, royal blue panels and the denim cap as the single saturated colour family running top to bottom, muted grass green as the sustained secondary, and the white piping, socks and platform sneakers as the lightest values.

Let's start with the 3 image references, one for the environment and 2 for the characters. You can find the Midjourney prompts in the ALTs of the images.

Then, use them as reference in Seedance 2.5 along with this prompt

Hyper-kinetic non-stop combat, zero pauses, every shot full of motion, extreme high-intensity action filmed like real footage, overcast misty daylight, drifting mountain fog, aggressive handheld 35mm with heavy motion blur, whip pans and hard cuts every 1-2 seconds, crash zooms, debris and water spray constantly in the air, ultra-realistic smoke, dust and particle systems.

Use the provided image <<image1>> as exact reference for the environment: grassy alpine meadow with grey limestone boulders, crumbling cliff edge with waterfalls pouring into the misty valley, limestone floating islands with pine trees and hanging roots, giant rock wall with hanging roots on the right, river far below. Use the  multi-view sheet as exact appearance lock for the beast <<image3>>: hulking gorilla-like brute made of dense billowing black smoke, twice the height of the samurai, massive shoulders and long arms, knuckle-walking on clawed hands, glowing red eyes with a band of red embers across its face, wisps of smoke rising off its back. Use the multi-view character sheet <<image2>> as exact appearance lock for the ronin samurai (black oni menpo mask, long black hair in a loose high ponytail, scarred dark skin, torn sleeveless off-white kimono top, single red lacquered shoulder guard, thick rope belt, katana and short sword in cracked red scabbards, bandaged forearms and shins, tattered blue-grey hakama, straw sandals).

0-2s: [Extreme Wide Crash-In] The beast charges across the meadow on its knuckles, smoke trailing; the samurai sprints at it, draws the katana mid-run. Collision. Shockwave of grass, dirt and black smoke.

2-4s: [Low Tracking] Beast swings a huge clawed fist; samurai slides under it on his knees, katana slicing through the forearm. The smoke splits and snaps back together instantly.

4-6s: [Whip Pan + Medium] Beast backhands him; he flies into a limestone boulder that shatters. He rolls out of the debris and is already running back.

6-8s: [Handheld Over-the-Shoulder] Three fast cuts in a row: diagonal slash across the chest, spinning slash across the ribs, rising slash under the jaw. Each cut sprays smoke and red embers.

8-10s: [Overhead Top-Down] Beast slams both fists into the ground. The meadow cracks open, a chunk of the cliff edge breaks off and falls with its waterfall. The samurai leaps across the crack at the last moment.

10-12s: [Orbiting Wide] The samurai jumps off the falling rock onto the nearest floating island, runs along its edge between the pine trees. The beast leaps after him, smoke stretching like a comet tail.

12-14s: [Dutch Angle Close Combat] On the floating island: beast swipes, splinters a pine tree; samurai ducks, draws the short sword with his left hand, now fighting with both blades.

14-16s: [Crash Zoom] Twin-blade flurry: katana to the shoulder, short sword stabbed into the glowing red eye. The beast roars, the red embers flare.

16-18s: [Low Angle Slow-Motion Ramp] Beast grabs him by the torso and hurls him off the island. He falls through the waterfall spray, catches a hanging root, swings and launches himself back up.

title: 一位明确成年的年轻东方幻想狐妖女性

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
花云在脚下散开，刀身划破月光。
跃起的一瞬，和服、发尾和花瓣一起失重。

四张连续场景：空中花云、琉璃水宫、枫火逆风、雪月花枝。
同一角色，不同极限机位，更强烈的动态和梦幻空间。

#webtomind #AI写真 #和服 #武士刀 #梦幻摄影 #GPTImage2

【GPT Image2提示词】
主题：
空中花云

主体：
纵向2:3的真实单人写真。明确成年的女性在浮空花云与云海之间跃起，人物占画面约七成，云层、巨大花朵、圆月、飘落花瓣和远处浮空鸟居自然入镜。成人时尚编辑摄影与角色扮演题材，人物保持成年年龄感，不得呈现未成年形象。极端机位只改变观看角度，不允许破坏自然人体结构：头身比约六点八到七头身，肢体比例真实，跃起动作符合人体重心和重力。

人物·表情：
表情采用「动作中被叫住」：正在跃起时被叫住，眼神从前方抬起转向镜头，嘴唇微开像刚要回应。

服装·姿势：
低领深 V 白紫改良和服，胸前主领口直接可见，关键区域由完整不透明内层覆盖；紫色腰带、白色花枝刺绣、白色足袋和草履构成穿搭。低领只呈现锁骨与领口线条，不放大身体轮廓。人物在空中完成回旋动作，身体侧转但胸廓朝向镜头约四分之三角度，双腿自然分开，一只脚抬起，另一脚向后伸展；和服袖摆、腰带尾端、发尾和花瓣同时向上扬起。仿制无刃武士刀向画面右侧横向挥出，刀尖远离人物和镜头，一手握刀柄，另一手自然张开保持平衡。双手五指完整、自然分开，不做复杂抓握。

背景·光线：
浮空花云、云海、巨大花朵、圆月、飘落花瓣和远处浮空鸟居组成空间。主光来自正面月光与柔和补光，人物脸部连续受光且明暗过渡均匀，云层和花瓣保持梦幻层次，不落在脸上形成光斑。

构图·镜头：
全身，机位贴地极低仰拍，仰角约60到75度，使用14-24mm超广角但严格抑制畸变。人物位于画面中央偏右，腾空动作占据画面主体，胸前深 V 领口作为服装细节保持可见，脸部仍是唯一视觉中心。人物头部、肩线、上身、腰胯、腿部和刀身保持同一运动透视轴。

质感·风格：
极限梦幻和服写真。云海、巨大花朵、花瓣、月光和轻微颗粒，画面动感强烈但不塑料。

负面：
未成年感，幼态脸，真实明星脸，身体比例异常，头身比不自然，头过大，躯干过长，腿部过短，肩胯透视不一致，肢体扭曲，超广角畸变，头部变形，大幅回身，后背视角，胸廓朝向偏离镜头，领口放大身体轮廓，衣料紧绷上提，刀尖朝向人物或镜头，实弹武器，暴力血腥，裸体，关键部位暴露，透明内衬，服装移位，身体局部特写，挑逗姿势，脸部随机光斑，局部漂白，第二套主光，复杂手势，多余手指，额外手臂，重复手，第三只手，肢体融合，廉价cosplay，塑料皮肤，文字，水印。

图像创作入口：https://webtomind.com/zh-CN/create/image

主体：
纵向9:16超真实智能手机自拍。画面主体是指定角色的成年真人化版本，不像任何真实明星、网红或名人。严格保留角色的脸部气质、发型、发色、瞳色、代表色、标志性饰品和身份特征，让观众能够立即认出该角色。

人物・表情：
人物保持真实协调的成年女性面部结构。眉梢微微挑起，一只眼睛轻轻眯起，嘴角扬起带有恶作剧意味的笑容，脸颊略微鼓起，调皮地直视镜头。表情活泼、自信、亲近，像拍照时突然做出的俏皮反应，不要夸张鬼脸或卡通化表情。

场景根据指定角色所属世界观自动生成，并选择适合户外自拍的开阔地点。

现代都市角色可以位于屋顶、校园外广场、海滨步道或城市高台；幻想角色可以位于高地草原、城邦露台、魔法学院庭院或遗迹平台；科幻角色可以位于空间站观景台、基地甲板或未来城市天台；东方幻想角色可以位于宫殿露台、云海栈道、山门平台或古城高处。

使用明亮自然的户外日光。天空光均匀照亮脸部，柔和阳光落在头发、脸颊、鼻梁、锁骨和服装边缘。人物与背景保持一致的光线方向、曝光和色温。脸部受光干净均匀，不出现树影、碎光、彩色反射或不规则光斑。
构图・镜头：
纵向9:16，接近iPhone前置摄像头的近距离自拍。镜头位于人物胸口以下，以明显但合理的低机位向上拍摄，形成轻微广角透视。

人物脸部位于画面上半部，肩颈、低领服装和举起的拳头自然进入画面。蓝天占据较大面积，白云形成简洁背景。允许轻微倾斜、不完全居中的取景和自然边缘裁切，但不要裁掉脸部，也不要让前景手臂异常放大。

Prompt: 
Use my uploaded portrait/selfie as the ONLY identity and facial reference. Preserve my recognizable facial identity and appearance naturally.

Vertical studio fashion editorial with an absurdist set-up: a woman with the face from the reference photo sits sunk deep into a black leather recliner in a fog-lit studio, one leg stretched straight toward the camera and the other bent, counting a thick stack of banknotes with both hands at chest height, eyes down on the money, expression completely neutral — no smile, no gesture, that indifference being what makes the joke work. Around her, a ring of live brown hens walks across the studio floor, several cropped by the left and right frame edges so more are implied off-camera, and loose banknotes are scattered across the floor. Wardrobe (womenswear): a cropped boxy black-and-white colour-blocked faux-leather jacket with a spread shirt collar, black sleeves, yellow and side panels and white curved front panels, worn open with the zipper down; an oversized plain white t-shirt underneath showing at the hem; a fine silver chain necklace with a small cross pendant; extremely wide-leg washed charcoal-grey denim cargo trousers with large flap side pockets and a cream drawstring hanging at the waist; and white leather Air Force-style low-top sneakers; dark curly hair. Camera — the main device: a very wide lens, 16–20mm, with the body almost resting on the floor. The extended foot closest to the lens is grossly enlarged and distorted, filling the entire lower third of the frame, while the body compresses backward and the head sits relatively small at the top; that proximity-scale exaggeration is what creates the sense of dominance — the viewer is literally at her feet. A strong diagonal runs from the foreground sneaker up to the face. Lighting: a single large soft key from above and slightly in front — short shadows under the chin and beneath the recliner, gentle modelling on the arm, specular sheen along the faux-leather panels, and clear falloff toward the corners and the back of the set; no strong side fill, so the flanks of the chair and the outermost hens drop to dark values; a faint second source behind right putting a rim on her shoulder and on the feathers of the hens on that side. Atmosphere: fine haze in the air separating the subject from the background and letting the grey cyclorama gradient from mid grey down to near black in the upper corners — real light falloff through smoke, not a digital vignette. Focus: relatively deep depth of field despite the angle — both the foreground sneaker and the face legible, with slight softening on the hens at the back, consistent with a wide lens stopped down. Grade: cool and desaturated environment with a blue-green cast in the cyclorama shadows, the only warmth coming from the hens’ red-brown feathers and the skin tones; medium-high contrast, dense blacks, controlled highlights, fine grain. Palette: cool cyclorama greys filling the background echoed by the washed charcoal denim, black leather and black recliner as the central anchoring mass, the white jacket panels and white tee as the single bright block placed exactly at the center of the body, warm brown feathers distributed in a ring around it, and the muted green of the banknotes plus the white sneakers as scattered light values across the lower third.

Let the nose tip and puckered lips enlarge naturally through proximity, with the mouth becoming the dominant focal point in the center of the frame.  Her eyes are half-open and slightly languid while looking directly into the lens. She wears clearly visible violet contact lenses, pale pink pearlescent eyeshadow, moist eyelid highlights, dense elongated black upper lashes, fine extended eyeliner and a soft pink flush beneath the eyes. Add distinct dewy highlights along the nose bridge and tip. Her lips remain fully closed and are pushed strongly forward into a circular, exaggerated kiss or fish-face expression, with no teeth visible. Use a muted rose-pink glossy lip product that looks moist and full while retaining fine realistic lip lines.  Her complexion is cool pale ivory with natural soft pink coloration across the cheeks, under-eye area and nose tip. The skin should appear smooth, cool, supple and slightly velvety to the touch while preserving small natural details around the nostrils, mouth corners and chin. Illuminate the face with soft neutral-white light positioned in front of and slightly above the camera, producing tiny dewy reflections across the forehead, eyelids, nose tip and upper lip. Allow cyan LED light from the environment to faintly color the outer cheeks, jawline and hair edges.  Give her creamy white-blonde or very pale platinum hair with dense blunt bangs, narrow face-framing strands and twin medium-to-high ponytails. A curled ponytail silhouette should remain visible on the right side of the frame. The hair should be smooth and soft with the even shine of a high-quality styled wig, but retain several slightly displaced strands caused by her sudden movement toward the lens. Keep a white cartoon-like hair clip with dark markings in the upper-right area of the final image.  She wears a white collared uniform-inspired shirt combined with wide black shoulder straps or techwear suspenders, including small cyan and violet-pink details. Place a close-fitting black choker with small silver circular studs around her neck, and let black-and-silver over-ear headphones rest below it. Set the scene inside a dim cyber-themed gaming room, streaming setup or futuristic equipment space using dark gray, blue-black and cool gray tones. Include blurred cyan LED strips, blue circular electronic equipment, dark mechanical forms and one defocused white ceiling light. Use shallow depth of field so the eyes, nose tip and lips retain the main clarity while the ponytails, shoulders and background dissolve into soft cyan-blue bokeh.  Avoid the polish of a conventional commercial beauty portrait. Preserve abrupt edge cropping, minor facial asymmetry, strong wide-angle perspective, displaced hair strands, lens-edge softness, subtle digital noise and small accidental focus inconsistencies. The cyan lights had just switched on; she has already leaned into the lens and is holding an exaggerated kiss in the center of the image, as though she will pull back and laugh a second later. The final mood is intimate through camera proximity, playful, slightly absurd, Y2K-digital and cyber-cute. Create a photorealistic 9:16 high-fashion backstage editorial image of the same adult woman

Place her backstage at a concert venue inside a cramped lighting-rig storage bay with stacked black flight cases, scratched silver metal case edges, scaffold poles, coiled black cables, blue stage tape, concrete floor, dim overhead work lights, and deep shadow behind the rigging. The space should feel real, industrial, crowded, and performance-adjacent, not like a polished studio or nightclub set.

Shoot from a low close three-quarter angle using hard direct flash. A black scaffold pipe cuts diagonally through one side of the frame as foreground pressure, while stacked flight cases compress the opposite side. The cable pile stays low and dark near the floor, adding texture without becoming the main subject. Crop from slightly above the head to below the knees, keeping the face, torso, pipe grip, waistline, and stagewear dominant.

Pose her leaning into the backstage rigging with one arm extended upward gripping the scaffold pipe, creating a strong diagonal line through the shoulder and torso. One hip shifts toward the camera, one leg crosses slightly forward, and the opposite hand hooks firmly into the belt buckle or waistband hardware. Her chin is slightly lowered, eyes locked near the lens, expression calm, severe, and magnetic.

Style her in a clean black sleeveless cropped stage tank built from heavy matte ribbed cotton with reinforced stretch, not jersey drape. The top has a high crew neckline, wide shoulder coverage, clean armholes, a straight cropped hem ending just above the waist, and subtle compression wrinkles where the torso bends. No twist knot, no slash cutout, no random diagonal opening, no hanging strap, no one-shoulder construction. The strength comes from fit, fabric weight, and contrast against the waistline.

Pair it with low-rise black structured micro shorts with a wide leather belt, oversized gunmetal buckle, side D-rings, small hanging chain loops, and subtle nylon cargo-tab details. Add sheer black thigh-high stockings with clean matte bands and black patent lace-up stiletto ankle boots with metal eyelets, slim heels, and a sharp pointed toe. The lower styling should feel stage-ready, tough, and intentional.

Jewelry should be ranked and hard-edged: small silver hoop earrings, one industrial ear cuff, a thick black onyx ring, and a narrow silver bracelet. No handbag, no clutch, no extra prop in the hands.

Lighting hierarchy: hard direct flash defines her face, eyes, cheekbones, torso, bare waist, belt hardware, patent boots, scaffold pipe, and scratched metal flight-case edges. Dim blue work-light spill catches the cable coils and chrome case corners. Keep deep shadow behind the stacked cases and under the cable pile so the scene stays gritty and compressed.

The minifigure has the classic cylindrical yellow head with printed black rectangular sunglasses, subtle eyelashes, and a lopsided smile, moulded dark brown hair falling from beneath a curved-brim brown camouflage cap, a matte dark brown hooded sweatshirt with subtle leather-grain surface texture, classic C-clip claw hands folded across the chest, a silver chain with a hanging pendant, a camouflage-print belt with a gold buckle, blocky dark brown legs with a chain hanging at the hip, and rectangular block feet. Wardrobe on the woman (streetwear): a curved-brim cap in black-and-white camouflage print, a washed charcoal-grey oversized hooded sweatshirt with small white screen-print lettering across the back, a black crossbody sling bag resting at the small of her back, a single black glove on her left hand, extremely wide black cargo trousers with patch pockets and a hanging chain, and chunky black lace-up boots. Lighting: flat diffused overcast daylight entering from the garage mouth, no hard directional shadows — only short soft contact shadows beneath both figures, a soft cast shadow falling to the left of the minifigure, and believable ambient occlusion in the folds of its hoodie, low contrast, neutral-cool temperature, nothing on the plastic brighter than the real scene warrants. Camera: vertical framing at chest height, frontal and centered on the gateway, symmetrical composition with the grille’s vertical lines framing both figures, wide depth of field with everything in focus. Palette: concrete and sheet-metal greys dominating absolutely, black and dark brown outfits as the anchor, camouflage repeating as a texture rhyme between the two figures, and the minifigure’s yellow head as the only pure color accent in the frame.
